text: The accepted view filters out Offline headers, then the local folder filters that result to Partial headers before marking their POP3 UIDLs FETCH_BODY. Keep the selectedMessages, messages and mDownloadPartialMessages roles separate. A scoped manual recommendation is to build derived collections with copy_if instead of mutate the selected collection while iterating. The landing adds no direct regression test for every selection/view combination. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Offline and partial flags filter different stages of Get Selected Messages
